next.reason: 1985: integer-1 is the leftmost column of the printable item (the only form). 2023 §2023:13.18.14.4 GR6 b) 'If LEFT is specified, integer-1 is the leftmost column of the printable item', and §2023:13.18.14.3 SR9 'If any of the operands is absolute and neither LEFT, CENTER, nor RIGHT is specified, LEFT is assumed'. Every 1985 COLUMN clause means the same; RIGHT and CENTER are syntax 1985 lacks.
